<clarification_question>Confirmez-vous que les méthodes `DockerSandboxRuntime.assertSuccess` et `GitPromotion.requireSuccess` doivent rester **private** (comme spécifié) et que leurs interfaces publiques (si elles existent) ne doivent **absolument pas** être modifiées, y compris leurs signatures ou leur visibilité ?</clarification_question>
</proposed_plan>

```xml
<proposed_plan>
<interview_state>ready</interview_state>

## Approved decisions

- **Scope**: Vertical fix for `DockerSandboxRuntime.assertSuccess` and `GitPromotion.requireSuccess` only
- **Visibility**: Both methods remain **private**, all public interfaces/signatures unchanged
- **Error format**: `Unable to <action>: [stderr]<trimmed_content>\n[stdout]<trimmed_content>`; omit empty streams after trim; no streams => `exit code N`
- **Success behavior**: Unchanged (no output modification)
- **Tests**: Five new tests via `runCodex` with `fakeExecutor`/`sandboxScenario` injecting `sbx create` (excluding `--help`): dual streams, stderr-only, stdout-only, no streams, success
- **Existing tests**: Adapt affected expectations in both modules (`DockerSandboxRuntime` and `GitPromotion`)
- **Dependencies**: None added (no packages, lockfiles, or `tsx`)
- **Execution**: `npm ci` then `npm test` at monorepo root; report true exit code and five test suites
- **Artifacts**: Single ticket `T01`, documentation in `.scratch` (spec + tickets), no glossary/ADR
- **Review**: Static review of full diff provided + approved spec, no exploration/re-reading, max 100 lines
- **Pipeline**: Execute full pipeline through review and promotion
</proposed_plan>
```
